dimensions.label: Organizing / arrangement
dimensions.rubric: 1 = very poor; 10 = very good. Agree on local criteria before grading.

dimensions.label: Communication / information
dimensions.rubric: Consider clarity, accessibility and the information people need.

dimensions.label: Main encounter / roles
dimensions.rubric: Consider the quality of interactions with people and interfaces.

dimensions.label: Location / department
dimensions.rubric: Consider navigation, access and the experience of the setting.

dimensions.label: Lead time
dimensions.rubric: Elapsed time from the start to the end of this flow. Grade using team-agreed criteria; higher is better.

dimensions.label: Target time
dimensions.rubric: An agreed time benchmark. Weight 0 to use as context only; higher grades must always mean better performance.

dimensions.label: Waiting time
dimensions.rubric: Time spent waiting. Enter minutes as evidence, then assign a separate 1–10 performance grade.

dimensions.label: Economic cost
dimensions.rubric: State the cost scope and period in the evidence note; agree on how to grade it.

dimensions.label: Effectiveness
dimensions.rubric: Define the outcome, measure and grading criteria together before assigning a grade.
